item.title: Vonn, Shiffrin and Brignone among the Olympic skiers voicing concern over receding glaciers
item.description: The host city is a fitting place for them to be talking about it.

item.title: CHP: Search launched after vehicle seen plunging into Eel River
item.description: First responders were still searching Wednesday for a vehicle that reportedly drove off Highway 162 and into the Eel River in Mendocino County Tuesday, the California Highway Patrol reported.

item.title: Snow coats inland valleys, more expected overnight
item.description: Light snow was observed at elevations down to about 500 feet, according to the U.S. National Weather Service in Eureka. In Redwood Valley, snow coated the surrounding hills as vehicles traveled north on U.S. Highway 101. The roadway remained wet, though light accumulation covered grassy shoulders and higher slopes.

item.title: Jesse Jackson’s 1988 presidential run inspired generations to carry his message
item.description: Jackson’s 1984 and 1988 presidential campaigns led Democrats to open up their primary system.

item.title: Loose dog makes Olympic cameo on the cross-country ski course at the Milan Cortina Games
item.description: A dog wandered onto the course and ran with athletes down the straightaway.

item.title: NIH’s Bhattacharya will also run the CDC while Trump administration looks for a permanent director
item.description: Bhattacharya will be the third leader of the embattled CDC during Trump’s second term.

item.title: FDA will drop two-study requirement for new drug approvals, aiming to speed access
item.description: The FDA has generally required new drugs be shown safe and effective in two trials.

item.title: WH adviser Hassett urges ‘discipline’ for Fed economists over tariff study
item.description: Several other studies have reached similar conclusions as the New York Fed.

item.title: Trump, weeks after backlash over racist post, hosts Black History Month reception
item.description: At the White House reception, Trump name-checked prominent Black Americans among his supporters.

item.title: Air Force One will be repainted as Trump has hinted, US military says
item.description: A “red, white, gold and dark blue paint scheme” will be used for the jet.
